verses.text: "I've seen all this with my own eyes. I've heard it with my own ears and understood it.
What you know, I know too. I'm not beneath you.
I want to speak to the Almighty himself. I want to argue my case with God.
You cover things up with lies. Every one of you is a useless doctor.
If only you'd keep completely quiet! That would show some wisdom.
Hear my argument now. Listen to the case I'm making.
Will you say things that are wrong on God's behalf? Will you lie for him?
Will you show him favoritism? Will you argue God's case for him?
Will it go well for you if he examines you? Can you fool him the way you fool another person?
He'll surely rebuke you if you secretly show favoritism.
Won't his majesty frighten you? Won't terror of him fall on you?
Your memorable sayings are proverbs made of ash. Your defenses are made of clay.
Quiet! Leave me to speak, whatever happens to me.
Why should I take my flesh in my teeth and put my life in my hands?
He may kill me. I have no hope, but I'll still defend my conduct to his face.
This too will be my salvation, because someone who is godless wouldn't dare come before him.
Listen carefully to what I say. Let my statement sink in.
Look, I've prepared my case. I know I'm in the right.
Who can press a case against me? If someone could, I'd fall silent and breathe my last.
Only grant me two things, and I won't hide from you:
take your hand far away from me, and stop terrifying me.
Then call, and I'll answer. Or let me speak, and you answer me.
How many wrongs and sins have I committed? Show me my rebellion and my sin.
Why do you hide your face and treat me as your enemy?
Would you frighten a leaf blown by the wind or chase after dry stalks?
You write bitter charges against me and make me pay for the wrongs of my youth.
You put my feet in stocks and track every path I take. You set a limit on where I can step,
while I waste away like something rotten, like a piece of clothing eaten by moths.
